rules: Resolve every stored entity and every link inside the authenticated institution before considering a capability. Missing or malformed joins deny access.

A permission lists eligible target contexts. Resolve the operation's canonical owner resource first, then use only declared eligible scopes reachable from it. An alternative context never bypasses the primary owner's checks.

A grant names an assignable context and a scoped resource. Exact matching requires the same context and identity. Ancestor matching requires include_descendants, the typed authority path and the owner predicate for that action.

A link in tenant_path verifies institution only. A link in authority_parents or an approved effective relation in authority_queries is the only allowed inherited permission edge. Do not traverse other relationships or search for arbitrary routes.
If an authority parent has a condition or purpose, treat it as a required predicate. A missing optional relationship contributes no parent.
Evaluate the domain owner guard and any affected subject, assigned marker, learner, current lease, publishing authority, independent approval, or issuer checks after resolving eligible grants.
For bulk or multi-target operations validate every affected row and the specific aggregate grant. Reject a cross-tenant or mixed-visibility batch before committing an academic transition.
Do not convert evidence pins, historical membership, provider roster or owning Course reference into classroom authorization.

bootstrap.entry_rule: CreateInstitution requires independently authorized deployment provisioning and no existing institution identifier. This control context is outside ordinary RoleAssignment. Creating a tenant does not confer rights in other tenants.

authority_parents.when: Parent is present and interval is enclosed.

contexts.owner_guard: Use current period and specific schedule or records capability. Period membership groups courses for reporting only. It does not grant roster or instructional authority.

ActivityVersion is authority-neutral by itself. A package launch uses the composite EnrollmentRelease and exact ContentPlacement route declared by that operation. A matching activity UUID is insufficient.
Verify appeal subject, current review assignment, independence and disclosure. Intake and adjudication permissions are distinct.

Resolve exact delivery, offering and published placement. Even a direct delivery grant requires appropriate academic duty, independence, assigned candidate population and version predicates for the command.
Verify current upload purpose, candidate lease, scan and same pinned attempt. Storage authority cannot mutate the assessment.

authority_parents.when: Enrollment is present and matches the exact candidate and delivery offering.
authority_parents.purpose: Candidate self access or separately eligible roster-scoped records purpose only.

contexts.owner_guard: Require candidate ownership or an eligible TeamSnapshot member for learner actions, and current applicable lease. For staff require actual assignment and duty purpose. Own learner scope may follow enrollment.person_id only after verification.
Pin exact item and response context. Never expose solution or marking keys through candidate authority.
Require sealed submission and a declared review, marking or release operation. Submission actor need not equal the assessment beneficiary.
Verify exact course placement and immutable package, active actor, authorized mode and writer generation. Read-only Browse and Review do not confer result write.

authority_parents.when: Owning unit is present and active for current actions.

contexts.owner_guard: Validate membership change policy and current cohort institution. A cohort role does not grant powers in offerings or groups occupied by cohort members.

authority_parents.when: Owning unit is present and active for current actions.

contexts.owner_guard: Validate current curriculum role, edition and draft or publication state. Course-level scope does not imply authority over an offering's learner records.

authority_parents.when: Owning unit is present and active for current actions.

contexts.owner_guard: Validate current enrollment, teaching assignment or separately delegated operational purpose. Owning Course is a required integrity join, never an authority parent.
Require scope over the qualification or exact issued credential and current public or authenticated disclosure policy. An optional verification token gives access only to approved limited claims.

authority_parents.purpose: Only self or separately authorized person-specific records access.

contexts.owner_guard: Require the matching active Person for self participation, or an assigned scoped official purpose. Resolve active SectionMembership or GroupMembership only for an operation explicitly using that roster scope.

authority_queries.when: Resolve membership at the current authoritative instant. Use an owner-pinned historical instant only when this command explicitly permits historical access.
Resolve membership at the current authoritative instant. Group context must be an eligible permission scope and group must belong to this offering.

contexts.owner_guard: Require authorized evaluator service mandate, approved pinned marking rule, active worker fence and sanitized result boundaries.

Resolve institution from the approved evaluator scope. Approving Principal is immutable attribution and may not be moved across institutions. An institution-approved evaluator release does not authorize arbitrary execution.
Require approved incident purpose and exact delivery, candidate and record custody. General delivery supervision does not reveal protected incident evidence.
Require approved external destination, current profile, processing authority and data-minimized projection.
Require exact platform/tool service scope, resource context, GradeItem mapping, tenant and authorized learner. No direct official grade release.
Require approved deployment role and registered tool issuer, audience, scopes and context. Configuration authority does not grant a learner launch or grade access.

authority_parents.purpose: Configuration and grading use only the separately permitted operation. This path never grants learner launch.

contexts.owner_guard: Check same-institution approved deployment, exact placement and active learner or authoring context. Launch and connector configuration are separate privileges.
Validate original producer, exact GradeItem and candidate EnrollmentRelease, private record scope and approved consumption purpose. Evidence remains inaccessible to unrelated staff or guardians.
Use the exact GradeItem and approved offering/records assignment. A GradeItem cannot authorize unpublished results, cross-class grading or candidate record access on its own.
Require authorized grade release or review purpose and check the exact selection, period, audience and academic visibility scope.
Learner access follows an active released revision, never the computed pointer. Staff needs authorized educational purpose and current offering, section or explicitly reviewed historical scope.
Require exact result and approval state. Return current or historical revision only to the allowed viewer. Revalidate a staff explanation before disclosing source evidence.

Institution context is its own tenant. Institution-wide scope management or academic grant inheritance requires the specific capability, descendants opt-in and applicable owner guard. Creation uses trusted deployment bootstrap authority outside an existing institution.
Require registered provider profile, allowed action, version, exact service mandate and connector state. Integration metadata authority does not grant the connected provider's academic records.

authority_parents.when: owner_kind is Course and the owner scope resolves to the same institution's Course.
owner_kind is OrganizationUnit and the owner scope resolves to the same institution's OrganizationUnit.

contexts.owner_guard: Owner kind and owner ID resolve through a typed branch. Apply the domain's explicit ItemBankGrant or specifically documented inherited bank policy, exact operation and answer-key disclosure. Neither RoleAssignment nor ownership alone bypasses these checks.

authority_parents.when: Section is present and belongs to this group's offering.

contexts.owner_guard: Require current group membership for participant actions. A group grant does not extend to another group, section or offering.

authority_parents.when: Owning unit is present and active for current actions.

contexts.owner_guard: Validate library version and rights, reuse policy and explicit publication capability. An offering role never authorizes its course's source library.
Require authenticated Principal is named marker or a separately authorized reassignment reviewer. Role inheritance alone cannot read or grade an assigned script.

authority_parents.when: Parent is present and current institution hierarchy permits it.

contexts.owner_guard: Validate tree ancestry at the current authorization epoch. An administrator's organizational role grants no unrelated personal records access.
Authorize bootstrap or scoped runtime credential under adapter profile. Verify origin, nonce, actor or bound session, exact occurrence, launch generation and expiry.
Verify active runtime capability, release and placement, and current writer lease when required. Course or offering administration grants no package session token.
Require approved package custody and installation profile. Package approval grants no learner enrollment or runtime session.
Require verified reviewer Enrollment, peer release policy and de-identification. Recipient enrollment or submitted work is not a reviewer assignment.
Verify exact owner delivery, reviewed policy and independent approval or current worker fence. Generic course access does not authorize marking or publishing.

For self operations require active Principal.person_id equals target. Other actions require their declared custody, relationship or directory predicate and scope. A Person grant never implies academic staff authority.

authority_parents.when: Owning unit is present and active for current actions.

contexts.owner_guard: Validate assigned program operation and person-specific record access separately. Program membership does not grant teaching or grade access in participating offerings.

authority_parents.purpose: Self or explicitly approved person-specific record access only.

contexts.owner_guard: Require program assignment and person-specific purpose or current own learner view. Program membership does not grant classroom authority.
Verify exact owner delivery, reviewed policy and independent approval or current worker fence. Generic course access does not authorize marking or publishing.
Require own issued record, approved current guardian relationship and category, or scoped registrar. Academic-period grouping does not grant access to other learners.
Require exact issued or authorized working revision, permitted audience and current artifact access. Old official revisions retain their history.
Require the exact provider identity and allowed units, model fields, source authority, approval and baseline. Feed authority is never general tenant roster management.
Require the requested section and current teaching or enrollment relationship. A Section does not derive authority from its roster members.
Frozen group and learner evidence does not convey current membership. Verify group offering and the candidate member's pinned enrollment and eligibility.
Require own authorized education record, registrar custody or explicit authorized recipient. A disclosure grant never grants underlying grade table access.
Require exact issued or authorized staged revision and current record disclosure purpose. Issued snapshot bytes stay immutable.
Require authorized target, format and transfer direction. Academic or student-data access is independently checked during review, activation and collection.
